title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 6.19 Abu Dhabi English Study Group
vocab:
ups and downs: 좋은일 안좋은일
conflict: 갈등, 충돌
close-knit: 긴밀히 맺어진
split up: 헤어지다, 나뉘다
face to face: 대면으로
send my best: 안부전하다
sentences:
Our members have split up.
Life has its ups and downs.
It has become harder for us to meet face to face.
Please send my best to your mother.
